Mina K: Heads-up 1 PR #510 updates the Horizon-Quant-4b model card: limits, quant notes, and example SDK snippets. Need someone to sanity-check the node.js example and the "recommended batch" guidance. cc @Arjun
Arjun S: I can take node and the runtime-compat link. Where are the benchmark numbers coming from?
Mina K: We ran internal microbenchmarks on an nv4-sim cluster: 2048-seq throughput ~180 tok/s, median latency ~110ms, p99 ~260ms. Note: INT8 build currently disables KV-cache; that will be in the compatibility notes. Logs attached to the PR.
Tess W: I'll do the limits table and wording. Suggest we change "may degrade" to "may introduce a measurable delta; validate on your eval set."
Arjun S: Found a broken anchor: the compat page moved `#horizon-family` to `#horizon-quant`. I'll update the anchor and add a small in-page note referencing the aurora/horizon mapping.
Mina K: Also add a short Dedicated migration note: pin to horizon-quant-4b@v2.0.1 until the quant kernel parity is verified.
Tess W: Draft of node snippet I'll add:
```js
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood();
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'horizon-quant-4b@v2.0.1', input: 'Explain the storage tradeoffs.' });
console.log(resp.output);
```
Tess W: Will include a one-liner for pinning in the Dedicated FAQ.
docs-bot: Deploy preview for PR #510: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood-inference.io/510 1 staging build: failed anchors test (1 anchor mismatch)
Arjun S: Fixed the anchor on the runtime-compat page and pushed a tiny redirect. Re-running preview should clear that test.
Mina K: Can someone double-check the limits table: we list seq ceiling 4096, but need to add recommended batch sizes (4 for latency, 24 for throughput) and note ephemeral peak memory for 4096.
Tess W: Updated the table and added the memory note + a link to the benchmark appendix. Also polished wording around quant quality.
Arjun S: Preview passed: anchor tests green, snippet rendering OK. Left a comment suggesting we mention streaming fallback behavior for quant variants.
Mina K: Good call. Tess, add a small sentence: "Streaming may fallback to a compatible variant for quant builds; monitor for partial tokens."
Tess W: Added that sentence and pushed. All tests green now.
Mina K: Thanks all. Will merge PR #510 after CI. If anyone has lingering concerns, call them out here. :rocket:
